name: Titanium.UI.iOS.PushBehavior
summary: Continuous or instantaneous force to apply to an item.
description:
A push behavior configures the continuous or instaneous force to apply to one or more items. To
define a push behavior:

  1. Use the [Titanium.UI.iOS.createPushBehavior](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#createPushBehavior) method to create and define the behavior.
  2. To define a force vector, either set the
     [angle](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.PushBehavior#angle) and
     [magnitude](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.PushBehavior#magnitude) properties, or set the
     [pushDirection](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.PushBehavior#pushDirection) property.
  3. Use the [addItem](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.PushBehavior#addItem) method to add items to the behavior.
  4. Add the behavior to an [Animator object](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.Animator).

examples.title: Simple Example

properties.name: active
properties.summary: State of the push behavior's force.
properties.description:
Set to `true` to activate the force or `false` to deactivate it.  Use this property rather
than removing and re-adding the behavior to the animator.

properties.name: angle
properties.summary: Specifies the angle of the force vector in radians.
properties.description:
To configure the force vector, you need to also specify the
[magnitude](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.PushBehavior#magnitude) property.

properties.name: magnitude
properties.summary: Specifies the magnitude of the force vector.
properties.description:
A value of 1.0 represents an acceleration of 100 points per second squared if the item is
100 x 100 points with a `density` of 1.0.

To configure the push vector, you need to also specify the
[angle](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.PushBehavior#angle) property.

properties.name: pushDirection
properties.summary: Specifies the direction of the force vector as an x, y pair.
properties.description:
For example, specifiying `{x: 0.0, y: 1.0}` indicates a positive upward force of 100
points per second squared if the item is 100 x 100 points with a `density` of 1.0.

Specifiying a negative value reverses the direction of the force.

methods.name: addItem
methods.summary: Adds an item to this behavior.

parameters.name: item
parameters.summary: View object to add to the behavior.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.summary: Removes the specified item from this behavior.
